messages:
dalia: heads up — planning to roll the new delegation flow that lets project keys impersonate per-project SA for routing/quotas. want to check telemetry & quota attribution before canary.
max: sounds good. what are the main open risks?
jun: biggest is attribution ambiguity when proxying across orgs — billing needs a single 'origin' for metering or we double-count. also quota enforcement has to prefer origin-project, not the impersonated SA project.
dalia: correct. current plan: 1) tag every proxied request with `x-origin-project` (immutable) 2) keep `x-impersonator` for audits only 3) metric labels: origin_project, effective_service_account, route_variant.
elaine: +1 on labels. but dashboards need to show both cost-by-origin and cost-by-effective-SA. ops wants an easy toggle to view either aggregation.
max: can we get the router to stamp both labels at ingress and then never rewrite them downstream? that avoids accidental attribution flips.
jun: router already has a stamping hook. code sketch: ```yaml
routing:
  stamp_headers:
    - name: x-origin-project
      source: key_metadata.origin_project
    - name: x-impersonator
      source: authz.impersonator_id
```
dalia: nice. question for infra-bot: will existing telemetry pipelines carry new labels without schema change? @infra-bot
infra-bot: @dalia new labels will show up but we need to add them to the metrics schema for high-cardinality sets. recommend sampling for origin_project unless whitelisted.
elaine: sampling is fine for global heatmaps, but for billing we need 100% accuracy for committed customers. can we whitelist committed org ids?
max: yes — add a `billing_whitelist` check in the router stamping step. non-whitelisted origins fall back to coarse buckets.
jun: rollout plan: stage 1 (internal + staging) — stamp headers + opt-in telemetry; stage 2 — enable billing whitelist for a test customer; stage 3 — enable impersonation routing with quota enforcement. each stage gated by dashboard signals.
dalia: what's the dashboard signal set?
elaine: primary: percent of requests with origin_project present (>99%), secondary: mismatch rate between billed_project and origin_project (<0.01%), tertiary: increased 5xx on routed paths.
ops-runbook: add a playbook entry: if mismatch rate spikes >0.1% then rollback routing flag `enable_delegation_routing`.
dalia: agreed. last question — any UX changes needed in console for customers to see effective attribution?
elaine: console needs a small badge on key detail page: "Attribution: origin_project -> effective_service_account" and a link to export CSV for billing. low effort.
max: cool. I'll open a canary PR to wire stamping + whitelist toggle. will drop link here when ready.
jun: please add regression tests for quota enforcement: scenarios where impersonated SA has deny-forced quota less than origin. expected: use origin quotas unless origin opts out.
dalia: thanks all. small follow-up: include a short sample of headers in the canary PR for QA, e.g., `x-origin-project: org-123`, `x-impersonator: proj-abc`, `x-route-variant: delegated-v1`.
max: noted — PR in ~2h. :thumbsup:
